text.title: FBI reportedly investigating apparent hack of its criminal database
text.body_text: - Published The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its criminal information database, US media report citing two people briefed on the issue. The National Crime Information Center (NCIC) database is used by federal and local law enforcement to share information on warrants and background checks. The BBC has contacted the FBI for comment. text.title: Home Alone sequel reportedly in development with Macaulay Culkin returning
text.body_text: A Home Alone sequel is reportedly in development with original star Macaulay Culkin set to return. According to Puck’s Matthew Belloni, Culkin met with Disney executives earlier this year with a pitch for a follow-up and now the project has been met with a green light. The new Home Alone film will bring the 46-year-old back to the franchise as…
text.summary: Christmas comedy hit is set for a follow-up from the point of view of the father with Seth Rogen as writer and producer A Home Alone sequel is reportedly in development with original star Macaulay Culkin set to return. According to Puck’s Matthew Belloni , Culkin met with Disney executives earlier this year with a pitch for a follow-up and now the project has been met with a green light. The new Home Alone film will bring the 46-year-old back to the franchise as Kevin McCallister for a comedy that, according to Deadline , will be from the father’s point of view. Continue reading...

audio.title: How bird poop and manta rays sustain a pristine coral reef
audio.description: Coral reefs are at risk around the world . So how do they stay so healthy on the remote Pacific islands of Palmyra Atoll? The answer might be in bird poop, manta rays and tree saws. NPR’s Lauren Sommer recently visited the islands and takes Short Wave on a tour of its conservation secrets and lessons for the rest of the world. Interested in more science in the news?
